name: Openwebninja Universal Scraper
description: Extract structured data from 35+ public web APIs using natural language. Covers local businesses, jobs, products, reviews, news, social profiles, real estate, and finance. Outputs to JSON, CSV, Webhook, S3, FTP, Airtable, Google Sheets, or Slack.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install openwebninja-universal-scraper@claude-community` from `OpenWeb-Ninja/openwebninja-skills` (`.claude-plugin`).

Extract structured data from 35+ public web APIs using natural language. Covers local businesses, jobs, products, reviews, news, social profiles, real estate, and finance. Outputs to JSON, CSV, Webhook, S3, FTP, Airtable, Google Sheets, or Slack.
